Storm Gunner
A standard-type unit.

Shield Gunner
A unit with excellent
defense.

Valkyrje
A lightweight unit with
excellent performance in
aerial combat.

Doll
A lightweight unit with
excellent mobility.

Sniper
A unit with excellent load
capacity.

Gryps
A highly agile unit that
excels in close combat.

White Hopper
A rabbit-shaped unit with
excellent jumping
ability.

MAIN WEAPON (Main Weapon)
A weapon for ranged
attacks.

SUB WEAPON (Sub Weapon)
A weapon for close combat.

Option
Additional equipment such
as bombs, shields and
expansion batteries.

Material
Used to strengthen a
Marionette's frame and
Armor. Stick materials
offer high strength, while
sheets resist special
attacks.

Maintenance Kit

Includes grease to keep
moving parts running
smoothly, and Repair Kits
for damaged parts. Perform
regular maintenance to
keep your Marionette's
performance from
declining.

CPU
Interprets the program and
sends commands to each
part. The last three
model-number digits
indicate clock speed. If
you want to create complex
programs, choose a CPU
with the highest
performance you can.

P-Card
A card for storing
programs. Larger-capacity
cards can store a greater
number of Program Chips.
Regulations allow you to
carry no more than four
spare cards!

Battery
A hybrid battery that
supplies a Marionette's
energy. Its energy is
converted to electricity,
but is used directly as
fuel when the Burner fires.
If you use the Burner
often, choose a Battery
with high combustion
efficiency.

Motor
The main Motor that powers
a Marionette. The number in
its model name indicates
Motor power. More power
enables more agile
movement, but low rotation
speed reduces top speed.

Burner
A Burner Set used for
jumping, acceleration and
deceleration. There are
various types emphasizing
jumping,
acceleration/deceleration
or fuel economy. Choose
one that suits your
tactics.

Balancer
Memory containing a
Marionette's
posture-control patterns.
These patterns affect how
long each action takes to
complete. Choose one to
suit the actions you want
to prioritize.

Damper
Absorbs shocks to the
legs. Greater rebound
force enables more agile
movements. Greater
damping absorbs shock to
the parts and reduces the
motions needed for
landings.

Dash Gear
A device for dash
movement. A lower gear
ratio provides a higher
top speed. A higher gear
ratio lowers top speed but
reduces the time needed to
reach it.

Brake
A gas brake for slowing
down during dash
movement. Three types are
available: Soft,
Intermediate and Hard.
Soft offers high braking
power; Hard offers high
wear resistance.

Radar
Detects enemies,
obstacles and other
objects. A wider
enemy-detection range
makes enemies easier to
find. However, a narrow
marking range makes it
harder to hit enemies, so
keep this in mind.

Armor
Protective plating
against enemy attacks. You
must purchase Armor that
fits the Marionette you
will use. Select that
Marionette before making
your purchase.
